procedure: EA-NEGONT-02 v0.9 §3.4 D/R/O (working; not frozen). Admission by reading: D, a claim on Aeneas (the model) with the entity named; R, a relation the archive states between the model and an archive object; O, an archive category applied to the model or to a class the field and the census source for it (AI models for ancient texts: B1, B5, B7, census intersection, evidence kind and worked question; parallels as evidence: B1, B2, B3, B5, census kind, unit, answers and does_not_answer; Latin inscriptions: B1, B3, B5, census text_object). A bare mention, a figural use, a keyword list or a reference line is not a claim. The string pass returns an O-class candidate only where a sentence also carries a term of the archive's category vocabulary; beyond it, every archive sentence matching a class pattern was read at its passage (scan over 1,716 texts: class (1) 3 sentences in 1 text, class (2) 20 sentences in 20 texts, class (3) 32 sentences in 24 texts; and the strings 'direction of dependence', 'literary dependence', 'dependence between', 9 sentences in 8 texts), and the admitted deposits read at the paragraphs named in each claim's locus.
